parish.description: Drives a running Parish/Rundale instance (parish-tauri --mcp-port 3030 or parish web --port 3030). Tools: parish_world_snapshot, parish_map, parish_npcs_here, parish_save_state, parish_submit_input, parish_new_game, parish_save_game, parish_load_branch, plus a tauri_invoke escape hatch. The backend MUST be running first — see AGENTS.md or run `bash parish/scripts/parish-mcp-backend.sh start`.
